subject: 수능특강Light 영어
title: 젊은 팬층 유치를 위한 야구계의 다양한 노력들
fullPassage: Baseball is facing a major hurdle with the aging of its fan base. According to 2015 research results, 50% of baseball viewers are 55 or older, up from 41% 10 years earlier. It is not just the fans attending games, but baseball viewers on ESPN, a major broadcaster of sports events, now average 53 years old. To deal with the aging baseball demographics, Major League Baseball is exploring different strategies to speed up the game. If a game lasts for three hours, that might be over an hour more than many younger fans can stand. It is similar to how the circus was too long. In the 1950s, people sat and enjoyed the game, but now distractions such as large scoreboards, mascots, swimming pools, merry-go-rounds, and numerous other distractions, including the all-important Wi-Fi, are used to entertain fans. Faced with an aging fan base, Major League Baseball is working to shorten the game's duration and add various distractions to attract younger audiences.
